components.name: Open water arcade bay
components.construction: One repeatable six-metre wide arcade, ivory marble with shallow warm blush veins, slender piers and a single pointed softly cusped open arch, gold edge moulding, simple flat cornice. Walk-through arch truly OPEN, no blue glass blocking it. Flat level walkway three metres deep, planar joining ends at x +/-3. Clear rear opening. Source grammar is Moon Palace, not elaborate rose Gothic main palace. Separate trims mount later.
components.attachment_face: Flat underside to platform; vertical end planes join S01 repeats
components.semantic_front: Facade outwards, +Y; vertical +Z; rear contact opposite front
components.design_basis: GEN-05 visible motif; isolated construction and metric dimensions proposed
components.component_family: Moon Water Palace — arcade, portal, corner and ghat sections
components.notes: Four labelled groups and their main/front/plan/side views are present. Arcade and corner arches visibly open; portal lower passage remains clear. Pearl/ivory hosts, gold mouldings and pale blue/amber accents derive from GEN-05, with extra resolved ornament proposed. All metrics and hidden depth are working proposals. The depicted stairs do not prove eight identical risers;1.2m is the stair floor rise, excluding raised cheek/parapet ornament. Cornices, pier caps and inset elevations are not identical measured projections. A repeated arcade must share one boundary pier, avoiding doubled columns or overlapping floors. Model the shell and cut openings first; retain trims as removable groups. Arcade roof/depth closure, exact L-corner footprint, stairs and hall rear joins require model review.

components.name: Central portal wall
components.construction: One rectangular ivory entrance facade host, twelve metres wide and eighteen tall, deep pointed central opening six metres wide and twelve high; lower four metres clear door passage, upper region prepared for amber/lilac glass insert later. Flat rear wall contact, rectangular side joins, small side pointed recesses, narrow flanking pilasters, gold arch edges. NO attached dome, minarets, stairs, pool or complete palace. Simple source cusped arch rather than main palace five-gate front.

components.name: Arcade courtyard corner
components.construction: A genuine L-shaped ninety-degree arcade corner, outer footprint six by six metres, same ten metre height, three-metre-deep covered walk on each arm. One open source-style pointed arch on each outward face, corner pier carries both arch springings; flat cornice wraps corner. Two open planar ends mate with S01. Readable top plan, hollow inner walk, not solid opaque corner room.

components.name: Ghat stair and pool edge
components.construction: One broad water-court stair module twelve metres wide and six metres deep: eight low ivory risers of 0.15m, tread0.45m, rising total1.2m; remaining2.4m depth a broad upper landing. Low rectangular end cheeks and gold rim on the parapet cap; no ornate attached shrubs. Clearly show stairs, upper landing and underside/support. Pool water excluded from model; reflect-pool straight banks use separate procedural repeats.
components.attachment_face: Bottom and rear earth contact; upper landing at platform height1.2m
